title: SessionStatus
description: Returned by session_status(). MUST always be available for OBSERVER role or above.

windows_completed.description: Total windows completed in this session (including continuations).

total_input_tokens.description: Cumulative input tokens sent to the LLM across all windows.

total_output_tokens.description: Cumulative output tokens received from the LLM across all windows.

facts_in_warm_state.description: Current fact count in warm state (Tier 2).

overhead_ratio.description: Current overhead windows / productive windows ratio.

remaining_budget.description: Remaining budget against cost caps. NULL if no caps set.

input_tokens_remaining.description: Input tokens remaining before max_total_input_tokens cap.

output_tokens_remaining.description: Output tokens remaining before max_total_output_tokens cap.
